categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in electromechanical components and high-precision subsystems, focusing on high-end transmission and motion control, including nano and micro-nano positioning systems, linear motors, direct drive motors, vacuum motors, torque motors, AC servo motors, incremental and absolute position measurement systems, high-end servo drivers, and multi-axis motion controllers. These products serve industries such as semiconductors, high-end machine tools, advanced electronic manufacturing equipment, automation, and smart manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include drive control and various direct drive motor technologies, with expertise in electromechanical integration and smart manufacturing solutions. The company develops energy-saving, high-stability, and high-efficiency products, including linear motors, absolute position measurement systems, high-performance 400V E2 drivers, and high-dynamic semiconductor precision positioning platforms. Production involves vertical integration with in-house development of key components, advanced manufacturing processes, and compliance with international certifications such as CE, UL, and functional safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are global semiconductor equipment manufacturers, high-end machine tool makers, advanced electronic manufacturing equipment producers, and smart manufacturing enterprises. The company’s products are widely used in semiconductor wafer handling, advanced packaging, defect inspection, AOI automatic inspection equipment, PCB manufacturing, and automotive automation. Major end markets include semiconductor, electronics, automation, and electric vehicle industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in Asia (notably Taiwan and China), Europe, and the Americas. It maintains a global sales network with localized service capabilities, leveraging group overseas subsidiaries and distributors to serve major industrial countries worldwide. The company also has manufacturing and R&D facilities in Taiwan and an investment in an Israeli subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company occupies a midstream position in the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of high-precision transmission and control components. It links upstream raw material suppliers (metals, plastics, optical scales, magnets, electronic components) with downstream equipment manufacturers in semiconductor, automation, and machine tool industries, providing integrated electromechanical solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing energy-saving, environmentally friendly, and high-performance products aligned with Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing trends. R&D focuses on multi-axis drive modules, nano-precision multi-axis controllers, high-protection large thrust water-cooled linear motors, and ultra-high precision multi-degree-of-freedom positioning modules. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and green technology to support sustainable growth and meet evolving customer demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electromechanical components and precision positioning systems. The company also provides integrated solutions combining hardware and software for motion control and smart manufacturing. Sales are conducted globally through distributors and group subsidiaries, with a focus on long-term customer partnerships and value-added services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major global players from Germany, Japan, the US, and China in the high-precision motion control and semiconductor equipment components market. It positions itself as a leading brand with the most comprehensive product line and strong vertical integration, emphasizing innovation, quality, and customer service to maintain competitive advantages and expand market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.25 billion, a 4% increase from 2023, with net profit after tax rising 132% to about NT$90.9 million. It maintains a solid asset base exceeding NT$6.6 billion and equity of over NT$4.1 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth, strong profitability improvements, and continues to invest around 12% of revenue in R&D to sustain innovation and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value through its comprehensive electromechanical integration capabilities, delivering high-precision, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly motion control solutions. Its products meet stringent international standards and customer requirements for speed, accuracy, and reliability, especially in semiconductor and advanced manufacturing sectors. The company’s strong R&D, vertical integration, global service network, and commitment to sustainability differentiate it as a trusted partner for cutting-edge industrial applications.
